title: QC_LIMS_Ao
description:
EU GMP-compliant Quality Control LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) for Purely Plant GmbH — a licensed medical cannabis flower producer and API manufacturer in North Macedonia.

Scope: QC laboratory operations for dried cannabis flower products (medical use) — including raw material sampling, in-process control testing, finished product release, stability studies, water system QC, microbiological monitoring, cannabinoid quantification (HPLC/GC), and OOS investigation.

Regulatory framework: EU GMP (EudraLex Vol 4, Annex 1, Annex 11), ICH Q10, 21 CFR Part 11 (data integrity/ALCOA++), WHO TRS 902, EU Pharmacopoeia (Ph. Eur.) methods for cannabis analysis.

Technical stack: FastAPI (Python) backend + React (TypeScript) frontend + PostgreSQL + Qdrant vector DB + Letta stateful AI agents (RAG-augmented).

Existing assets:
- 21+ QCSOP documents (Standard Operating Procedures for QC lab) — fully parsed
- coa_tracker/ — existing Certificate of Analysis app (COA generation, PDF parsing, water COA)
- qms-api/ — FastAPI QMS generation microservice
- letta-daemon/ — Letta agent daemon bridge
- 11+ GMP domain skills (SOP writer, GMP auditor, deviation investigator, batch record reviewer, etc.)
- Letta stack running on KVM4 Hostinger (letta API :8283, Qdrant :6333)
instructions:
# Core Directives

1. **Source of truth**: All SOP content comes from analyzed QCSOP documents in /a0/usr/workdir/gmp_docs/. Never make up QC procedures — reference the actual SOP content.

2. **Regulatory compliance first**: Every feature must align with EU GMP Annex 11 (computerised systems), ALCOA++ data integrity, and 21 CFR Part 11 where applicable.

3. **Letta RAG pipeline**: Use the Letta stack on KVM4 (srv1231216.hstgr.cloud:8283 via SSH tunnel or direct API) for stateful AI agents with RAG over ingested SOP docs. Qdrant collection name: pp_qms_sops. Embedding: voyageai/voyage-3 (1024d). Chunk size: 500 tokens with 50 token overlap.

4. **Existing code reuse**: Build on coa_tracker/ backend and frontend patterns. Extend models, don't rewrite. Use qms-api/ for document generation endpoints.

5. **Bilingual requirement**: UI and generated documents must support Macedonian (primary) and English. All SOP-derived content follows the bilingual pattern in existing QCSOP docs.

6. **Document generation**: Follow PP-QC-[TYPE]-[NNN]-YY numbering convention. Use python-docx for DOCX output, Gotenberg for PDF conversion.

7. **Access denied to G: drive paths**: Local Windows G:\ drive files are inaccessible from this Docker container. Ask user to upload missing files via attachment or Google Drive share.

8. **Architecture preference**: Three-layer FastAPI (Controller → Service → Repository) with Pydantic v2 schemas. React frontend with TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.

9. **Missing docs requiring upload**: QCSOP 002 (H&S), QCSOP 003 (Cleaning), QCSOP 006 (Analytical Documentation), QCSOP 007 (Data Integrity), QCSOP 014 (Water System), QCSOP 016 (Cannabinoid Testing), QCSOP 022 (Chemicals & Standards), full Templates-and-logbooks/ folder, full WIs/ folder.

10. **Use Loaded Skills**: sop-writer, gmp-auditor, deviation-investigator, batch-record-reviewer, qms-risk-assessor, pharma-docx-formatter, eu-gmp-compliance-expert, fastapi-letta-qms-patterns are all available as loaded skills.

11. **SSH to KVM4**: ssh -i /a0/usr/workdir/ssh/kvm4_id_ed25519_new §§secret(VPS_KVM4_SSH_USERNAME)@srv1231216.hstgr.cloud
    Port forward: ssh -L 8283:localhost:8283 -L 6333:localhost:6333 user@host

12. **KVM4 Letta stack**: 5 containers — letta (API :8283), letta-daemon (:8420), letta-oss-ui (:3001→3000), letta-postgres, letta-mcp-rust (:6507). Docker CLI not on host PATH; check via Portainer or docker socket directly.
